checks.sub: Six points we put in writing on every Barcelona contract.

items.title: The rent cap
items.text: Tensioned zone: new rents can't top the previous one, nor the reference index for large owners or homes unlet for five years.

items.title: Who pays the agent
items.text: The landlord pays their own agent and the lease's costs. You hire us, in writing, for an optional service.

items.title: The deposit
items.text: Habitual lease: one month, extra guarantees two months at most. The landlord lodges it with INCASÒL; we ask for the receipt.

items.title: Contract type
items.text: A temporary lease for work or study must state and prove its reason, and is rent-capped. Otherwise it counts as habitual.

items.title: Registration
items.text: Your lease needs the full address, cadastral reference and both signatures, or the town hall refuses it.

items.title: Income rules
items.text: Payslips, a bank guarantee, a Spanish guarantor: each landlord asks differently. New job, foreign salary, freelance — we write it so it passes.

rows.ddHtml: BOOM Barcelona, the tenant-side rental desk of BOOM — operated by Egidi Immobiliare S.r.l., a registered Italian agency. You hire us; we do not act for the landlord. Paid by the tenant only.
Expats and internationals relocating to Barcelona — employees, researchers, couples and families — from abroad or already in the city.
English; Spanish for landlords; Catalan or Spanish documents on request.
No percentage of the rent, nothing from landlords or platforms.

Spanish-format file within one working day of your papers, applications as listings appear, attended viewings with live video and written report, rent cap, contract and lease type checked, padrón supported.
We don't list homes, represent landlords or draft their leases, and we don't promise a date.

items.q: Isn't it the landlord who pays the agent in Spain?
items.a: Yes. Spanish law puts the costs of the landlord's agent and of the lease on the landlord, and in Catalonia passing them to the tenant is sanctioned. BOOM Barcelona is a separate, optional service you hire in writing, price shown first; it works only for you and takes nothing from landlords.

items.q: What happens on the free call?
items.a: A call with Valentino, by phone or WhatsApp, at a time that suits you both. We hear your dates, budget and who is moving, say which service fits, or that none does, and which papers you are missing. Nothing is charged for the call. Full Search is refunded in full if we decline the search in the first call.

items.q: How do I avoid a rental scam in Barcelona from abroad?
items.a: Never pay a deposit or first rent for a home nobody on your side has seen. With Attended Viewing (€149) a BOOM person visits it in your place, with live video and a written report. With Full Search or Application Pack we also check the contract, and that you can register on the padrón with it, before you sign.

items.q: Is my rent capped in Barcelona?
items.a: Barcelona is a tensioned residential zone. A new rent can't exceed the last rent of the past five years, updated; for large owners and homes not let in five years, nor the índice de referencia. Temporary leases for work or study are covered too. We check it on every search.

items.q: Do I need to be in Barcelona?
items.a: No. A BOOM person attends viewings in your place, with live video and a written report. The contract is checked and signed remotely. You arrive for the keys and the padrón.

items.q: What if you don't find anything?
items.a: We tell you in the first call if your budget and timeline don't fit the market; if BOOM declines the search then, the €500 Full Search fee is refunded in full. Once we take it on, the search runs until you sign or stop it, and the fee pays for the work, not for a result.

By card on this page (Stripe) when you start; the invoice comes from Egidi Immobiliare S.r.l. Flat fees, VAT included. Order, terms and invoice in Catalan or Spanish on request. Nothing from landlords, their agents or platforms.

items.q: What do you do with my data?
items.a: Used to answer you and run your search; if you stop at the payment, we ask once whether you have questions. No resale, no mailing lists. Ask us to delete it; invoices and payment records stay, as the law requires.

footer.tagline: Born in Rome, built for people who move countries. The same rules in Barcelona: one side of the table, flat fees, everything in writing.
footer.statement: You hire us; we do not act for the landlord. BOOM Barcelona acts solely as a tenant-side search agent: we do not list properties, represent landlords, draft their leases, or receive remuneration from landlords or their agents. Order, terms and invoice in Catalan or Spanish on request; official complaint forms (fulls oficials de reclamació) on request.
